Per project extraction policy these Section XI Main Notes are documented in the Chapter 51 / 54 / 62 extractions and are NOT duplicated here. section_notes left empty.

Description Export Policy Policy Condition') were recognized as table chrome and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.

Headings 5802, 5803, 5804 (description rows) and parts of 5807 / 5808 appear in ALL CAPS in the PDF (e.g., 'TERRY TOWELLING AND SIMILAR WOVEN TERRY FABRICS...', 'GAUZE, OTHER THAN NARROW FABRICS OF HEADING 5806', 'TULLES AND OTHER NET FABRICS...'). The canonical mixed-case heading description text (matching standard ITC(HS) nomenclature) is used in the heading 'title' field; PDF capitalisation preserved is documented here.

The '?' characters are OCR/encoding artefacts in place of typographic double quotes. Preserved verbatim in supplementary_notes.

Treated as a single 5803.00 subheading with 10 tariff lines (the PDF reflects the post-2007 HS structure where 5803 lacks sub-classification).

Heading 5805 follows the same pattern as 5803 — '580500' subheading row with three 8-digit tariff lines (58050010 Tapestries hand made or needle worked by hand, of cotton; 58050020 Tapestries of jute; 58050090 Other).

Heading 5809 PDF text reads 'Woven fabrics of metal thread and woven fabrics of metallised yarn of heading 56.05, of a kind used in apparel...' — note the dotted form '56.05' in the heading description (HS 4-digit cross-reference style). Subheading row 580900 description references 'heading 5605' (without dot). Both preserved verbatim.

Heading 5808 description in PDF spans two rows: 'Braids in the piece; ornamental trimmings in the piece, without embroidery, other than knitted or crocheted; tassels, pompons and similar articles.' Concatenated verbatim.

Tariff line 5808.90.60 'Saree falls, borders (other than zari), frings of man-made fibre' — same typo 'frings' preserved verbatim. Also uses singular 'fibre'.

Tariff line 5801.90.10 'Pile fabrics and chenille fabrics of silk containing more than 50percent by weight of silk, but not containing wool or hair' — '50percent' rendered as one word in PDF (no space). Preserved verbatim.

The 'Export Policy' column shows 'Free' for every tariff line in the chapter — captured at the tariff-line level if relevant elsewhere, but not part of the description text. Unit-of-measure column is NOT shown in this chapter's PDF — unit field set to null for all tariff lines.

Chapter title on the PDF reads 'Chapter 58 Special Woven Fabrics; Tufted Textile Fabrics; Lace; Tapestries; Trimmings; Embroidery.' The canonical ITC(HS) Chapter 58 title (all caps form) is used in the title field; source_pdf preserves the PDF filename.

Chapter Note 1 says 'This Chapter does not apply to textile fabrics referred to in Note 1 to Chapter 59, impregnated, coated, covered or laminated, or to other goods of Chapter 59.' This is the only formal exclusion in the chapter notes; captured in exclusion_clauses. Chapter Note 4 ('Heading 5804 does not apply to knotted net fabrics of twine, cordage or rope, of heading 5608.') and Chapter Note 6 ('The heading does not apply to needlework tapestry (heading 5805).') are heading-specific exclusions also captured in exclusion_clauses.

chapter_notes.text: This Chapter does not apply to textile fabrics referred to in Note 1 to Chapter 59, impregnated, coated, covered or laminated, or to other goods of Chapter 59.
Heading 5801 also includes woven weft pile fabrics which have not yet had the floats cut, at which stage they have no pile standing up.

For the purposes of heading 5803, "gauze" means a fabric with a warp composed wholly or in part of standing or ground threads and crossing or doup threads which cross the standing or ground threads making a half turn, a complete turn or more to form loops through which weft threads pass.
Heading 5804 does not apply to knotted net fabrics of twine, cordage or rope, of heading 5608.

For the purposes of heading 5806, the expression ""narrow woven fabrics"" means: (a) woven fabrics of a width not exceeding 30 cm, whether woven as such or cut from widerpieces, provided with selvedges (woven, gummed or otherwise made) on both edges; (b) tubular woven fabrics of a flattened width not exceeding 30 cm; and (c) bias binding with folded edges, of a width when unfolded not exceeding 30 cm. Narrow woven fabrics with woven fringes are to be classified in heading 5808.

In heading 5810, the expression "embroidery" means, inter alia, embroidery with metal or glass thread on a visible ground of textile fabric, and sewn appliqu work of sequins, beads or ornamental motifs of textile or other materials. The heading does not apply to needlework tapestry (heading 5805).
In addition to the products of heading 5809, this Chapter also includes articles made of metal thread and of a kind used in apparel, as furnishing fabrics or for similar purposes.

supplementary_notes.text: 1. (a) For the purpose of this chapter, ?Lucknow Chikan craft? refers to a type of embroidery defined and recognized by the Geographical Indication (GI) Registry against the GI no. 119 under the Geographical Indication of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999. (b) Produced/Manufactured by a person certified/recognized and mentioned as a user in the Geographical Indication Registry against the said GI no. 119.
